up: Retrieve all IC50 values (in nM) for compounds tested against the human single protein target 'Pim-1 kinase' (taxonomy ID 9606). Return one row per activity, including the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, compound key (from compound_records), PubMed ID or DOI (preferring PubMed ID), assay description, target ChEMBL ID, target preferred name, target type, and the organism name. Do not filter on assay confidence score, target type, document type, or data validity.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(d.pubmed_id, d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.target_type,
  td.organism AS target_organism,
  a.standard_value AS ic50_nM
FROM activities a

JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno

WHERE
